forecast_contract.oos_baseline: constant discovery-period mean return for the same series/horizon
forecast_contract.oos_model: univariate OLS intercept/slope fit on discovery only; coefficients frozen in holdout
forecast_contract.overlap_control: greedy non-overlapping forward episodes; exact weekdays use the 1W end index
forecast_contract.tail_cutoffs: discovery-period predictor q10/q90 frozen before holdout

information_contract.release_anchor: first market close on/after Friday release target

predictors.delta_1w_net_oi_pp: signed weekly change in actor net position as percentage-points of open interest
predictors.position_percentile: expanding historical percentile of the actor's net/OI position level
predictors.signed_change_percentile: expanding historical magnitude percentile with the sign of the weekly change

purpose: Frozen OOS predictive-power and correlation verification baseline.
